verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a way to plug an external coding agent into a Make project to drive the builder, such as an MCP server, API, or agent bridge. Make's MCP support runs the other direction: Make connects out to external tools as context, which is client-side and adjacent. Manual code editing and multiple built-in chats are not external-agent control either. A community report that Figma's API returns 400 for .make files further suggests no programmatic access path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect my own coding agent to the project so it drives the builder alongside or instead of the built-in one
